name: 08611 · Trenton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08611 (Trenton) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08611 (Trenton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08611 (Trenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
